highlights.title: Clearer headings
highlights.description: Home and Settings now use matching headings that are easier to read.

highlights.title: Simpler reset options
highlights.description: Each reset has one icon. Reset Leave Records stays off until you have a leave record.

highlights.title: Matching leave icons
highlights.description: Loss of Pay now uses the crossed-out rupee symbol throughout the app.

releaseNotes: Matching headings, clearer reset options and consistent Loss of Pay icons.
